# SegmentedControl

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:segmented-control` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

## When to use

Controlled exclusive choices in toolbar, rounded-rectangle, and pill presentations.

- Expose a small controlled exclusive choice set.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for tabpanel semantics or many choices.

**Alternatives:**

- [TabBar](./tab-bar.md) (nearest)
- [Select](./select.md) (nearest)
- [Button Group](./wa-button-group.md) (prefer-over)

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/segmented-control` — exports `SegmentedControl`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/segmented-control` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/segmented-control.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/segmented-control`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuisegmented-control) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `compact-exclusive-choice`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [LucideIcon](./lucide-icon.md).

## State and wiring

- value — controlled (required)

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Every enabled choice remains in sequential tab order.
- Every choice has a meaningful label.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-segmented-control`, `kui-segmented-control__item`.

Never put `kui-segmented-control`, `kui-segmented-control__item` on an element you write; render `SegmentedControl` instead (`KUI-L103`).
